amazon-launch-checklist v1.0.0

- Initial release of Amazon product launch audit agent.
- Performs automated readiness scoring for new Amazon listings across core launch components.
- Provides detailed audits on keywords, images, pricing, PPC plan, and launch timeline.
- Generates prioritized action lists, launch plans, and workspace organization per product.
- Prevents launching incomplete listings by flagging blockers and readiness bands.
